title: How to Build an ROI Calculator With AI (In Under an Hour)
summary: Build a custom ROI calculator that converts prospects before your next sales call. No code, no Typeform, no Google Sheets. Database, auth, and hosting included.
body_markdown: Yes. The database is automatically included with every Blink project. Tell Blink to save each calculation with the inputs and the email address if provided. The admin view shows all saved calculations so your sales team can see what each prospect entered before a call.
